notes: Access: plain requests GET via the shared probe harness, no blocking anywhere (Shopify storefront; robots.txt explicitly allows crawling. The same unsolicited promotional note the prior Home-Decor pass found in robots.txt was again ignored as untrusted third-party content, not an instruction). TREE: taken from the site's own mega-menu HTML in the homepage source (ul.navigation__tier-1 > li.furniture-menu and li.outdoor-menu; mm-hd column headings with mm-inner children), then cross-checked against the category chip lists rendered on /collections/furniture, /collections/outdoor and each of the four room landing pages, and against the full collections sitemap (sitemap_collections_1.xml, 725 collections) grepped for every furniture slug term in the brief. Two top-level furniture departments exist: 'Furniture' (/collections/furniture, 20455 products) with four room columns Living Room / Dining Room / Bedroom / Office, and 'Outdoor' (/collections/outdoor, 2305 products, page title 'Luxury Outdoor Furniture') with Outdoor Seating and Outdoor Tables columns; the latter is emitted under category 'Outdoor Furniture' because the site names it as its own department. Two leaves came from the department chip lists rather than the mega-menu: Dining Sets and Outdoor Furniture Sets. COUNTS: the rendered listing header ('N products', sitting next to the collection title and the Filter/Sort bar) was used for every leaf. Shopify collections.json products_count was NOT used - the prior pass proved it inflated on this exact store. Header exactness was re-proven this session by full /collections/<handle>/products.json pagination exhaustion (limit=250, walked to an empty or short page, deduped by product id) on nine collections spanning three orders of magnitude: poufs 4, bar-carts 57, display-cabinets 63, headboards 83, outdoor-side-table 138, media-cabinet 251, benches 410, sofas-sectionals 504, coffee-tables 1506 - all nine matched the rendered header exactly. Counts were also re-read a second time on sofas-sectionals (504), nightstands (924) and outdoor-benches (221) with zero drift. Numbers differ per category, so there is no site-wide-total artefact. ALIAS CHECK: page-1 product-ID sets were compared pairwise across all 44 candidate collections. Exactly one collision - /collections/armoire-wardrobe is identical to /collections/dressers (same 648 products), so 'Armoires & Wardrobes' carries qty null plus a flag instead of double-counting. SHARED COLLECTIONS: /collections/benches is linked from three rooms (Benches / Dining Benches / Bedroom Benches), /collections/sleepers from Living Room and Bedroom, /collections/bookcases-etageres from Living Room and Office - each is emitted exactly once. Poufs (4) is largely a subset of Stools & Ottomans (3 of its 4 ids) but the site lists the two as siblings in the same mega-menu column, so both are kept as the site presents them. EXCLUDED: 'Office Accessories' (/collections/office-accessories, 114) - its full products.json sample is desk and table lamps, i.e. lighting, not furniture. 'Outdoor Accessories' (106) - mixed bucket (18 planters plus the garden stools); the cleaner /collections/garden-stools (88, pure stools) was taken instead. 'Outdoor Umbrellas' and /collections/umbrellas-and-umbrella-stands (62, all umbrellas). 'Outdoor Pillows' and Pillows & Throws (textiles). The whole Rugs department, Pillows & Decor, Mirrors & Art and Lighting - each mega-menu was dumped and inspected; no furniture node hides in any of them. DROPPED AS NON-CATEGORIES: New, New Outdoor Arrivals, Outdoor Bestsellers, Best Sellers, 'Shop Dining Chairs', 'Shop In-stock Furniture', 'Shop Outdoor Seating', 'Shop Outdoor Rugs', the Brands menu and every vendor collection in the sitemap (bernhardt-furniture, century-furniture, hooker-furniture, meridian-furniture, sunpan-furniture, vanguard-furniture, woodbridge-furniture, fairfield-chair, hickory-chair, bdi-furniture, luonto-furniture and their promo/non-promo/disco variants). ORPHAN SITEMAP COLLECTIONS rejected because they are absent from every nav and superseded by a nav node: /collections/desks (440, a strict superset containing all 432 products of office-desks), /collections/writing-table (18, wholly inside desks), /collections/dining-bar (0 products, empty), /collections/pub-table-30, /collections/safavieh-bistro-chairs, /collections/outdoor-accent-chair (singular duplicate of outdoor-accent-chairs) and the 6008/6915/6920/6931-computer-desk SEO stubs. PARENT vs CHILD: the department and column collections here are separately curated Shopify collections, not unions of their children - Bedroom shows 1865 while its children sum to 2423, and Outdoor Seating shows 309 while its children sum to 824. No parent number was therefore ever used for a leaf; every leaf qty comes from that leaf's own listing page.
